conventions.S_M: S^(1)(Delta) = int((2E(A)+2A,A^*) - (2E(lambda)+3lambda,lambda^*) - (2E(c),c^*)), M = v. for v = 2E

conventions.bracket_sign: {S_M, -} = + D_M (measured exactly: {S_X,F}/(D_X F) = 1 for F = int(A,A), int(dA,dA), int(lambda,dslash lambda), int(dc,A^*))

conventions.canonical_form: two-point functional = alpha(p) delta(Sigma) + beta^mu(p) (d_mu delta)(Sigma), field leg first, its momentum p fixed, Sigma = total momentum (the x-explicit S_M produces the d delta part)
conventions.odd_parameters: coefficient of (xi, r_odd leg); Hessian of xi S_M = -xi Hess(S_M)

conventions.notation: L2 := log|p|^2 + gamma_E + log 2, L3 := log|p|^2 + gamma_E + log 3; eps-dependence only through eps|p|^2 (log eps coefficient = log|p|^2 coefficient in every entry)

task2_component.comparison_with_eq:c6-step2: C - [2 s d/ds sigma_s O[infty] - Q(4 unit tree(field-counting -> O[infty]))] = z_2 unit D_M O + Q(Y1a). (c6-step2) holds up to the scheme rescaling z_2 and the term Q(Y1a) != 0. Y1a exists only because (Q^GF)^2 != 0; with a gauge fixing satisfying (Q^GF)^2 = 0 the internal insertions vanish and (c6-step2) is exact.
task2_component.Q(Y1a) structure: Ward identity at X: bubble part (local after Q) + |p1|^2 x triangle. Symmetrised local part of the bubble: -4 O - D_M O. The |p1|^2 part is not a pure equation-of-motion term (That ~ p1/|p1|^2 as |p1|^2 -> 0), so this split does not define an O-coefficient; using it anyway would give -2 (traceless) and -26 (trace), contradicting the protection of the traceless bilinear.
task2_component.IR / well-definedness: Y1a UV and IR convergent at generic momenta (composite line ~ l^-3 at l -> 0, derivative part ~ l^-3); single Feynman-parameter monomials of the r-derivative terms are spuriously IR divergent after elimination of u_1, resolved by homogenisation; the x-explicit S_M makes all graph values distributions (delta, d delta), resolved by the canonical form; no IR scale used.
task2_component.locality_of_component: C is not of the form (local functional)[infty] at one loop: Q(Y1a) is nonlocal (logs/dilogs of k^2, |p1|^2, |p2|^2 ratios) and no local functional of weight 2 and degree -1 exists to absorb it; same mechanism for translations (beta(Y1a) is -i times the translation internal-insertion graph).
